provenance.prompt: Use Anna's captain portrait from the third row, fifth column of the referenced roster atlas as her face/hair guide. Generate a transparent 42-pose sprite atlas in exactly6x7 order. Adult human woman; warm bronzed skin, blue-green eyes, dark brown hair tied back, confident graceful expression; athletic-curvy strong body with natural fullness. Sea-green and warm-orange basketball sportswear, no magic or species changes. Hand-inked 2D 1990s arcade illustration. Poses1-6 idle,7-10 ready with empty hands,11-20 low right-handed dribble with pose16 at lowest reach,21-31 forward run,32-42 low-dribble run with pose37 at lowest reach. Full unclipped right-facing figures, true transparency, no ball, no prop, no text, no floor, no glow, no fringe.
